executions.name: The Call
executions.script: She restages it: she puts them exactly where her people were, gives them the same defensible, arithmetic, correct choice — and then makes the decision the Vanguard made, out loud, in their voice.

executions.name: Honourably
executions.script: She kills them the right way. Clean, fast, respectful, by the book — the book she still knows by heart. She closes their eyes. Then she takes the medal.

desecration.name: Recanted
desecration.script: The thrown medal does not knock them down, it goes through; the freeze-frame is the medal spinning on the floor and her already walking.

overdrive.name: CONVICTION
overdrive.script: Both halves at once for four seconds, alternating hero and villain technique. BRIGHT ends with her catching them. DARK ends with her not.
